claims.statement: The product is melody-in-heart (applicationId cn.com.dcsgo.mihx), a purely local offline-first Android music player with no INTERNET permission, running Kotlin 2.0.21 + Compose (BOM 2025.09.01) + Media3 1.9.0 (with Jellyfin FFmpeg decoder) + Hilt 2.52 + Room 2.6.1 + DataStore 1.1.1 + WorkManager 2.9.1 + LiteRT 1.4.1, at versionName 3.15.0 / versionCode 54, minSdk 33 / targetSdk 36 / compileSdk 36, Java 11 bytecode, split into 15 Gradle modules (:app, :core:model/common/ui/skin, :domain, :data, :player, six :feature:* modules, :benchmark).

verifyProductArchitecture is a Gradle task registered in the root build.gradle.kts verification group and wired into the root check lifecycle; since m-10 (2026-10-15) the rule body lives in buildSrc as pure logic (ProductArchitectureVerification.verify(rootDir) returning all violations at once, unit-tested by ProductArchitectureVerificationTest) rather than an inline doLast block. It statically asserts module boundaries (no :data/:player/cross-feature deps from features, no implementation-layer import leaks, no :core:model Android resources/UI resource ids, MusicRepository kept as an internal coordinator bound via narrow adapters), the Hilt entry points and DI modules, immutable Room schema snapshots (incl. locked v1/v2/v3), LazyColumn stable keys, AppLog over android.util.Log, no stale cn.com.dcsgo.mihx.data.player package references, release R8/resource-shrink settings, privacy backup excludes, no READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE, no startup-path permission requests, and no Android Things references; a GradleException reports every violated rule.

./gradlew check aggregates the root spotlessCheck, the root verifyProductArchitecture, and every one of the 14 subprojects' own check tasks (each subproject's check also depends on its spotlessCheck covering Kotlin/Kotlin-script/XML formatting); it must be run before committing.

The 15-module layering is: :app shell (AppRoot/AppNavHost/AppRoutes, PermissionCoordinator, emotion scan worker, shell/skin resolver, app-level Hilt modules) depends on all other modules; six :feature:* modules depend only on :core:* and :domain and expose the Route+Screen pattern; :domain holds repository interfaces plus pure playback policy with no Android dependencies; :data owns Room MelodyDatabase and DataStore wrappers with narrow adapters; :player owns AppMediaSessionService, PlaybackController, windowed queue planning, Bluetooth coordination, and EmotionAnalyzer support; :core:model/common/ui hold pure data types, logging/trace, and shared Compose components, and :core:skin holds the skin description model, parser and fail-closed validation.

Offline and privacy invariants: the app manifest declares POST_NOTIFICATIONS, FOREGROUND_SERVICE, FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK, BLUETOOTH_CONNECT and READ_MEDIA_AUDIO with no INTERNET permission; READ_MEDIA_AUDIO is accepted solely to accelerate the import scan (fast java.io.File traversal when already granted) while SAF document-tree access remains the primary/fallback path, and verifyProductArchitecture forbids READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE and bans startup-path requests for notification/Bluetooth permissions (only user-triggered Settings paths may request). Backup and data-extraction rules must exclude the legacy SharedPreferences files, melody.db plus journal/shm/wal, the player_settings and playback_state DataStore files, and the album-art cache. MelodyApplication is a Hilt @HiltAndroidApp + Coil ImageLoaderFactory that installs AppLog (performanceLoggingEnabled=true) with PerformanceTrace whitelist call sites, installs an uncaught-exception handler and schedules EmotionScanScheduler from onCreate, and its Coil loader caps memory at 20% and disk at 64 MB while deferring image-stack init to first load.

Room persistence is MelodyDatabase v20 with 14 entity classes (songs, playlists, playlist-song cross-ref, play stats, playback events, quick-skip songs, quick-skip short plays, song group overrides, migration state, artists, albums, song-artist cross-ref, song_emotions, word_preferences) and exportSchema=true with JSON snapshots 1.json..20.json under data/schemas/; DatabaseModule registers MelodyMigrations.ALL (19 migrations, MIGRATION_1_2 through MIGRATION_19_20) and provides SharedPreferencesLegacyJsonMigration as the first-launch v1 SharedPreferences-JSON-to-Room import; historical schema JSON must never be edited.

Five DataStore preference files complement Room: player_settings (theme, play modes, Bluetooth/notification toggles, lyric font scale, sleep timer, emotion scan pause, mood-time-slot master switch), playback_state (playback snapshot persistence, owned by :player's PlaybackStateStore with a legacy music_player_prefs SharedPreferences), playlist_resume (per-playlist resume JSON), mood_time_slot (time-slot configs as a single-key JSONArray), and emotion_failures (per-song failure JSON with attempts counting); all are excluded from backup.

Emotion batch scanning is scheduled from MelodyApplication.onCreate via EmotionScanScheduler as WorkManager unique periodic work (emotion_periodic_scan) every 6 hours under charging + battery-not-low constraints with a 30-minute initial delay and NetworkType.NOT_REQUIRED; the periodic EmotionScanWorker analyzes up to 40 pending songs per run while the manual trigger (manual=true, unique name emotion_manual_scan) analyzes up to 300 per run and, while a gap remains and it was not paused mid-way and not wholly failed, auto-enqueues the next batch with ExistingWorkPolicy.APPEND.

EmotionAnalyzer (cn.com.dcsgo.mihx.player, @Singleton) uses FfmpegPcmDecoder (a MediaExtractor + Jellyfin FFmpeg decoder driving the same media3 extension used for playback, chosen after a MediaCodec vendor-soft-decode SIGSEGV on some ROMs) to decode mono s16 PCM, resamples to 16 kHz, then runs per-window YAMNet embedding + emotion_va_head.tflite in :player assets (model version 'yamnet-va-v5-vocal@edbf6fe5', 5s window / 2.5s hop) producing valence/arousal curves and a whole-song vocalScore; both decoder and analyzer share a memory budget derived from maxMemory() to deterministically truncate high-sample-rate tracks instead of OOM, failures carry a displayable EmotionFailureReason, are persisted to EmotionFailureStore, and songs accumulating MAX_ATTEMPTS=3 failures stop being auto-retried.

Analysis results persist in the Room song_emotions table (SongEmotionEntity: valence, arousal, curveJson of raw per-window [v,a,...] floats, peakSec, windowsAnalyzed, durationSec, vocalScore, modelVersion, analyzedAt, plus base64 1024-dim embeddingB64, userValence/userArousal/userTags and userTagsEdited calibration/derivation columns) through SongEmotionsRepository implementing the :domain SongEmotionRepository interface.

Mood time-slot semantics: TimeSlotConfig holds included emotion tags plus an optional excludedTags list; MoodSlotResolver (:domain, pure logic, independently unit-tested) treats configs as left-closed/right-open [start, end) intervals with end <= start meaning cross-midnight, picks the earliest-starting hit on overlap, and validates saves returning SlotValidation (empty name, name too long, neither include nor exclude tags chosen, an excluded tag also included, zero-length interval, conflict with an existing slot), which TimeSlotConfigStore turns into IllegalArgumentException. PlayerRandomQueueFacade drops songs whose excluded-tag ratio reaches MoodSlotPolicy.EXCLUDE_MIN_RATIO (= EmotionGroup.MIN_RATIO = 0.15) before filtering by included tags at MATCH_MIN_RATIO = 0.35, falls back to the full post-exclusion library when the include pool is empty, and warns when the pool is below POOL_WARN_THRESHOLD = 10; MoodPoolStats reports excluded/matched/available for the slot editor using the same thresholds.

PlayerViewModel is a deliberately thin @HiltViewModel facade delegating to PlayerRuntime, a composition root injected via PlayerRuntimeFactory that lazily assembles graph objects (PlayerQueueGraph, PlayerMediaControllerGraph, PlayerPersistenceGraph, PlayerBluetoothGraph, PlayerPlaybackSessionGraph) and per-concern facades (library, import, playlist, song-deletion, quick-skip, controller-queue, queue, controller-state, playback, media-event, version, random-queue, lifecycle, error, playback-bridge, startup); the old PlayerViewModelComponents assembly hub was deliberately dismantled and verifyProductArchitecture fails the build if any file references it again.

Queue invariants: PlayQueue.songs is the full business queue (duplicates allowed; currentIndex indexes into it) while MediaController only holds a windowed plan whose size stays between 51 and 71 items (20 before + current + 50 after, clipped at queue edges) for 100/500/1000-song libraries as locked by PlaybackWindowPerformanceShapeTest; SongMediaItemMapper sets MediaItem.mediaId to Song.id.toString() as the mapping contract back to the business queue; navigation goes through MediaController, not PlayQueue index arithmetic.

Build variants: debug (no minification, applicationIdSuffix .debug so it coexists with release), release (R8 minify + resource shrink, arm64-v8a only, resConfigs zh/en, falls back to debug signing without keystore.properties unless -PrequireReleaseSigning=true makes the build fail), and benchmark (initWith release but debug-signed, non-debuggable, adds x86_64 for emulators); :benchmark is an Android-test (com.android.test) module targeting :app with StartupBenchmark (cold-start StartupTimingMetric, with and without a baseline profile) and ScrollBenchmark (FrameTimingMetric) run via :benchmark:connectedCheck.

Navigation: AppRoutes is the Navigation Compose route table for the shell (home, playlist, playlist/{id}, artist/{name}, album/{name}, user, settings, lyrics, playback-stats, play-stats/raw, play-stats/effective, quick-skip-songs, song-top-list?period=, file-check, duplicate-detail, version-management, version-comparison/{groupId}, storage-stats, emotion-analysis, mood-time-slot, skin-switcher). The former compile-time AppDestinations enum of three fixed bottom tabs was replaced in the P2 shell rework by a data-driven AppShell (tabs, startRoute, miniPlayer, playerEntry, myPageSectionOrder, librarySongListTemplate) resolved from the active skin, with RouteAffinity.owningTopLevelRoute porting AppDestinations.fromRoute sub-page-to-tab attribution (routes it does not classify, such as storage-stats, fall back to home) plus List<AppTab>.indexOfRoute/tabForRoute for highlight; app-shell ViewModels such as MoodTimeSlotViewModel must be created at Activity scope in AppRoot, because creating them inside NavHost composable blocks falls back to a non-Hilt factory and crashes.

Test tiers: JVM unit tests (./gradlew test, no device) live in domain/, player/, data/, feature/*/, core/* (including core/skin parser/validation) and app/ test sourcesets covering planners, synchronizers, repositories, facades, and skin/shell resolution; instrumented Compose tests (HomeScreenComposeTest, PlaylistScreenComposeTest, SettingsScreenComposeTest, RuntimePermissionPolicyTest) run via :app:connectedAndroidTest on an emulator/device; Macrobenchmarks run via :benchmark:connectedCheck with EMULATOR suppression for x86_64 simulators, though MIUI ROMs may block them.

The Room word-preference feature: a new word_preferences table (WordPreferenceEntity with word PK, likeVotes, dislikeVotes, updatedAt), migrations creating/rewriting it registered in MelodyMigrations.ALL, the :domain WordPreferenceRepository interface (observeAll/getAll/recordSongOutcome/clearAll) backed by :data WordPreferencesRepository, and the WordPreference.kind majority-vote classification (LIKE/DISLIKE/NEUTRAL) in :core:model; votes are counted on song settle via PlayerRuntime.handleExploreSongSettled calling recordSongOutcome with ratio-weighted integer votes (share × 100, ExplorePlaybackPolicy.VOTE_WEIGHT_SCALE). The domain ExplorePlaybackPolicy defines INITIAL_BATCH_SIZE=10, REFILL_COUNT=5, REFILL_THRESHOLD=0, MIN_LISTEN_MS=30000, MIN_LISTEN_RATIO=0.25, VOTE_MIN_RATIO and VOTE_MAX_TAGS, and isSkipped() as the pure completion-vs-skip judgment shared with vote counting.

Explore play (探索播放) is a distinct RandomEnhanceMode (OFF/TIME_SLOT/EXPLORE, mutually exclusive with TIME_SLOT) surfaced on :feature:player via playerSettingsRepository.randomEnhanceMode: PlayerRandomQueueFacade.playRandomQueue (async, onResult callback) generates ExplorePlaybackPolicy.INITIAL_BATCH_SIZE=10 songs and sets isExplorePlay (disabling infinite random), refillExplorePlayQueue adds REFILL_COUNT=5 songs when the just-ended song was second-to-last (REMAINING==REFILL_THRESHOLD=0, measured in PlayerMediaEventFacade.handleMediaItemEnded), and buildExploreRefillPool tiers candidates by liked-and-no-dislike → only-no-dislike → full library using WordPreference.kind; PlayerRuntime observes the mode to set isExploreModeActive and exits the explore session when the mode leaves EXPLORE.

Since v3.12 the word-preference vote scale is ratio-weighted: vote weight = per-word share of the song × 100 (ExplorePlaybackPolicy.VOTE_WEIGHT_SCALE / voteWeightOf), so a skipped/kept track weights its dominant emotion words far more than incidental ones; MIGRATION_15_16 multiplies all historical word_preferences likes/dislikes ×100 to keep old 1-vote-per-word counts on the same scale, and because WordPreference.kind is a relative comparison (likes-vs-dislikes) the rescale does not flip any classification.

MIGRATION_16_17 (the v16→v17 schema step) adds only index_songs_albumId and index_playback_events_songId — the former serving album-directory queries and orphan-album cleanup (which run on every persistence/delete/dedupe/file-validation) and the latter enabling DELETE playback_events WHERE songId IN (...) equality lookups that previously scanned the whole append-only table; exported schema is now data/schemas/17.json.

The emotion model coordinate system is 'yamnet-va-v5-vocal' (EmotionModelSpec.MODEL_VERSION, generated from core/model/emotion_model_spec.properties by :core:model's generateEmotionModelSpec task): arousal is a real RMS loudness envelope mapped through a [-30,-5] dB floor/ceiling window (DB_FLOOR/DB_CEIL), valence is calibrated by V_CAL_BIAS=0.25 and V_CAL_SCALE=0.85, and vocal-compensated anchors shift instrument-dominant (vocalScore <= VOCAL_COMP_THRESHOLD=0.010) tracks' valence up by VOCAL_COMP_SHIFT=0.091 at read time; changing the model fingerprint auto-triggers rescan of rows whose modelVersion mismatches.

EmotionScanWorker selects pending songs as (analyzed[id] != EmotionAnalyzer.MODEL_VERSION || id in songIdsMissingVocalScore) && uri != null && attempts < MAX_ATTEMPTS, so both model-version mismatches and rows missing a vocalScore (written before v14) are auto-repicked; the periodic batch size is 40 and the manual batch size 300, and a manual run re-enqueues the next batch with ExistingWorkPolicy.APPEND only when it was not paused mid-way and a gap remains, aborting instead of requeueing when every attempted song in the batch failed (guards against an infinite failure loop).

PlayerRuntime.playRandomQueue(onResult) and startInfinitePlay(onResult) are async: they launch the suspend facade planner off the main thread (scope=viewModelScope=Main for the callback) and report (started, moodSlotName) via the callback; PlayerViewModel mirrors them with the same onResult signature for election-slot attribution toasts.

Repository conventions live in three non-wiki files: AGENTS.md declares the generated openwiki/ tree optional just-in-time context, asks for the narrowest quiet validation and forbids hand-editing generated pages; README.md is the Chinese user-visible feature contract that fixes UI labels such as 本地音乐, 文件管理, 存储与音质统计, 深度校验 and 音质档位; docs/README.md indexes the design records in docs/. CLAUDE.md is only a short OPENWIKI pointer stub forwarding to AGENTS.md and carries no version or schema facts, so version truth must come from app/build.gradle.kts plus gradle/libs.versions.toml and schema truth from MelodyDatabase plus data/schemas/.

Audio specs are persisted on Song/songs as sampleRate, bitDepth, bitRateKbps, channelCount, audioCodec (track MIME) and spatialAudio, with 0/""/false as unknown sentinels; the quality tier is never stored — Song.qualityTier derives it via AudioQualityTier.classify (lossy: below 192 kbps 标准, 192–319 较高, 320+ 极高; lossless codec set: >=24-bit and >=48 kHz 高解析, >=16-bit and >=44.1 kHz 无损, DSD straight to 高解析, otherwise UNKNOWN), Song.qualityLabel returns an empty string for UNKNOWN so the UI shows nothing, and spatial audio is recognized only for audio/eac3-joc or audio/ac4 with channelCount > 2 (plain E-AC-3 / audio/ec+3 is not spatial).

File verification has two modes: QUICK re-extracts metadata only for songs whose size:mtime file fingerprint changed, while DEEP re-extracts every song with a live URI; refreshMetadata re-reads bitDepth, bitRateKbps, channelCount, audioCodec and spatialAudio (alongside title/artist/album/sampleRate/duration/cover) in parallel and writes only changed rows in a single batch, deliberately leaving spatialAudio untouched when the codec MIME cannot be read so a previously recognized true is not cleared — this path is the only backfill for rows persisted before migrations v17->v18 and v18->v19.

存储与音质统计 is a read-only shell destination (AppRoutes.STORAGE_STATS = "storage-stats", no ViewModel) reached from the 文件管理 card; its AppNavHost block keeps only songs with a non-null uri, obtains a songId->bytes map through PlayerViewModel.measureLocalSongFileSizes -> MediaStorageStatsRepositoryImpl (persisted songs.size first, otherwise SAF OpenableColumns.SIZE then statSize, max 8 concurrent queries), and feeds it to the pure LocalMusicStorageStats.from, which yields total bytes, measured/unknownSizeSongs coverage, spatialAudioSongs re-derived with the current isSpatial rule, and per-tier counts plus ratios for every AudioQualityTier including zero-count tiers.

SongSortMode has eight values (IMPORT_ORDER, TITLE, ARTIST, ALBUM, DURATION, BIT_RATE, PLAY_COUNT, LAST_PLAYED) and is persisted orthogonally with a separate ascending flag in the player_settings DataStore; BIT_RATE replaced the old sample-rate mode and SongSorter compares Song.bitRateKbps, while PlayerSettingsRepository.songSortMode maps a legacy persisted "SAMPLE_RATE" value to BIT_RATE on read (unknown values fall back to IMPORT_ORDER), so the switch needed no schema or preference migration.

Same-song version groups are keyed by Song.groupKey = titleOverride ?: title + artist + album joined with a U+0001 separator (defaultGroupKey); manual association stores the target group's full key and manual detach stores "标题#id". Because pre-v20 stored plain titles (attach) or "标题#id" (detach) cannot be mapped onto the new key, MIGRATION_19_20 deletes every song_group_overrides row so users re-associate once after upgrading, and it occupies its own version because folding the DELETE into the unreleased 18->19 would never run on devices already at v19; the v20 schema JSON is unchanged because the migration is data-only.

The playback page shows read-only current-song emotion pills above the progress row: PlayerViewModel.currentEmotion combines uiState with SongEmotionRepository.observeAll (avoiding the single-row query that would drag embeddings along), is stateIn WhileSubscribed(5_000), flows through NowPlayingSurface into HomeRouteState.emotion, and HomeScreen computes emotionTagRatiosOf(...) so each pill shows the word with its ratio and nothing renders when the ratio map is empty.

Persisted preference state is split across five Preferences DataStore files: player_settings (settings, sort mode, enhance mode), playback_state (owned by :player), playlist_resume, mood_time_slot (time-slot config JSON array) and emotion_failures (per-song failure reason and attempt count as JSON).

GitHub PR Check (.github/workflows/pr-check.yml) runs on pull_request and on push to main, ignores docs/, openwiki/ and **.md changes, and executes ./gradlew check :app:assembleDebugAndroidTest :buildSrc:test --no-daemon --stacktrace on ubuntu-24.04 with JDK 17 so instrumentation sources compile without a device; a push whose diff touches only versionCode/versionName lines of app/build.gradle.kts takes a conservative fast path that skips the heavy check, while anything else (an extra file, an extra changed line, a new branch, a force push or a non-push event) runs the full check.
